description: This Java class defines a REST controller for importing book data from a file, specifically handling multipart form data uploads for LibraryThing data. It processes the uploaded JSON file, deserializes it into internal data structures, and delegates the import operation to a service layer.

classes.name: BookImportController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller that handles importing book data from a multipart file upload, specifically for LibraryThing data.

methods.name: importFromLibraryThing
methods.description: Handles POST requests to import book data from a multipart form file, deserializes JSON content, and delegates the import process.
